provenance.designBrief: Dité survivor of the exact MGS3 Snake incarnation. Patchwork olive tiger-stripe fatigues with sealed boot gaiters, patched cold-war canvas poncho folded at back, antique field oxygen filter strapped on chest, scavenged ceramic forearm protection and handmade crystal-resistant pack. Preserve young MGS3 face and normal human body, no Diamond Dogs logo, no Venom horn, no later-era body. Mk22 and CQC knife as inherited, field repairs bespoke.
